details:
Since quest doesn't have transparency, materials and mesh count are extremely limited and there's no other good means to hide geometry I sometimes hide the parts by moving them really far away using shape keys which makes these parts of the mesh sensually invisible.

This method has an issue which causes the name plate to appear way higher than the avatar bounding box.

I don't own a quest so I could only test this on PC.

Steps to reproduce 

   1. Upload an avatar with a shape key that moves a large part of the mesh really far away (1000000m in my case).

   2. Animate or set the shape key to some value in Unity before upload

   3. Load the extreme-shape-key-avatar in game

   4. With the extreme-shape-key-avatar join to a world with an other user

   5. The other user will see the name plate high up

Reproducing this seems to be inconsistent. 

If the extreme-shape-key-avatar switches to a different avatar and then back, the nameplate may get fixed.

If the other user joins the extreme-shape-key-avatar, the nameplate will work properly.

I have created ready to upload VRChat avatar unitypackage to test this bug https://drive.google.com/file/d/1MCfOHYpVFeYNnotjc6qbAwARDEu6Y4zn/view?usp=sharing

Pictures explained in order:

a. Name plate in game

b. Shape key in Blender multiplied by 1/1000000

c. Unity bounding box

d. Reproducing this bug with an other avatar (this avatar is in the google drive file linked above)
title: [1359][BUG] Extreme shape keys cause nameplate to appear high up
